relations.rationale: Nell finishing ahead of Ivo does not indicate anything about how well Kira's and Ivo's designs performed relative to each other.
Spectators clapping at checkpoints doesn't establish relative speed differences among robots.
Clapping for checkpoint clearing has no bearing on Kira adjusting wheels after a collision.
Spectator clapping doesn't determine finishing order between Kira and Nell.
Clapping at checkpoints is unrelated to the color of Noor's robot.
Clapping at checkpoints does not relate to how visible Noor's robot was.
Spectators clapping during checkpoints is a separate event from the later gathering to compare notes, with no causal link.
Relative robot speeds have no connection to relative ages of participants.
Some robots being faster than others doesn't relate to who the oldest participant is.
That some robots were faster than others is consistent with two specific designs working equally well, so it slightly supports the possibility but doesn't strongly determine it.
Watching timers closely is consistent with and suggests noting completions carefully, supporting the claim.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira doesn't imply anything about Kira adjusting her robot's wheels.
If Ivo finished ahead of Kira, then Kira cannot have finished ahead of Nell if Nell also beat Ivo, but on its own this doesn't directly contradict Kira beating Nell.
Ivo's finishing position relative to Kira has no bearing on Leo helping others solder.
Finishing order between Ivo and Kira doesn't relate to the number of parts in their designs.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira suggests his robot performed better, which contradicts the claim that their designs worked equally well.
Adjusting the robot's wheels after a collision supports the idea that Kira hoped to improve her robot's balance.
Kira adjusting her wheels after a collision doesn't determine her finishing position relative to Nell.
Kira's wheel adjustment has no bearing on the visibility of Noor's robot.
Kira's mid-event wheel adjustment doesn't directly relate to the later gathering to compare notes and pack up.
